heading_en: Transitional Measures for Capital Instruments Included in Capital Before Promulgation
summary_ja: 公布前に長期・短期劣後債務に該当していた自己資本を、平成25年3月30日まで補完的項目・準補完的項目とみなす。
summary_en: Treats capital that was long-term or short-term subordinated debt before promulgation as Supplementary Items or Quasi-supplementary Items until March 30, 2013.
paragraphs: Capital that, before the day of promulgation of this Public Notice, falls under long-term subordinated debt prescribed in Article 176, paragraph (2) of the Cabinet Office Order or short-term subordinated debt prescribed in paragraph (3) of that Article is deemed, until March 30, 2013, to be the Supplementary Items prescribed in Article 6 or the Quasi-supplementary Items prescribed in Article 7, respectively.
